exit_bar_daily_diagnostic.time_axis: stored exit-bar UTC date, NOT available outcome date
exit_bar_daily_diagnostic.units: Each stream retains its own saved units. Liquid123 already has its native portfolio_risk_scale; no unscale, weighted mixture or combined Net is computed.
exit_bar_daily_diagnostic.use: Retrospective co-movement only, no fitted cutoff, allocation rule, causal feature or evidence of independent opportunity.

exit_stamp_ambiguity.native_clock: exit_ts is native bar-open label; intrabar execution/availability timestamp absent
exit_stamp_ambiguity.stored_stamp_convention: Strict [entry_ts,exit_ts); zero-span labels have empty intervals, not proved zero holding time.
exit_stamp_ambiguity.upper_model: [entry_ts,exit_ts+1h); one frozen source interval, an upper model only within that exit bar. No latency/delivery or cross-bar physical bound asserted.

exit_bar_end_upper_model.qualification: Overlap in the explicitly named timestamp model, not measured execution occupancy.

stored_exit_stamp_half_open.qualification: Overlap in the explicitly named timestamp model, not measured execution occupancy.

inherited_parent_scope_excluded_from_clo.reason: Long-only256 is a closed-row parent subset. Copied parent open/rejected records cannot be allocated to it or counted as additional opportunities.

legacy_stamp_predicate_reproduction.predicate: A.entry < B.exit_stamp AND B.entry < A.exit_stamp; assumes nonempty intervals
legacy_stamp_predicate_reproduction.qualification: Historical arithmetic reproduction only; zero-span stamped rows violate the nonempty-interval assumption. No physical-fill or portfolio claim.

limitations: Neither 106/123 legacy overlap nor correlations select a strategy or prove portfolio suitability.
Saved closed rows omit changed admission/occupancy opportunities; a zero-entry date is not proof of absent signals.
The common source-envelope denominator includes all intersected UTC/Berlin dates and partial edge dates; exit-active-date correlation is separately labelled.
No output adds or averages the two saved economic streams, invents 50:50 sizing, or promotes trading authority.

opportunities.limitation: Same-symbol/side/time clusters ignore strategy names. Saved admitted/closed rows do not enumerate rejected, unavailable or counterfactual opportunities.

shared_account.reason: No shared-state replay, capital/mark path or observed outcome clock; different saved risk units remain separate.

source_windows.derivation: Intersection of every reported symbol envelope [first_bar_open,last_bar_open+1h).
source_windows.qualification: Metadata envelope only. No OHLC byte archive, continuity, actual outcome availability or independent OOS is certified. Declared boundaries precede retained 1000-bar ranges.
